notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.
